title: Sweet Blue Flowers
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Childhood friends Akira and Fumi reunite in Kamakura after ten years. Fumi, a shy lesbian girl at Matsuoka Girls' High School, dates the popular senior Yasuko, while Akira joins her own school's drama club and tries to support her friends through heartbreak and family pressures. Over two school years the friends' relationships deepen, and the story ends with Akira considering going out with Fumi.
life_message: Being honest about who you love, and supported by patient friends, is how young people grow up.

content.note: Same-sex romance central; Fumi's past sexual relationship with her older cousin (Wikipedia; MU First-Time Intercourse, Nudity; AniList Yuri).
Fumi hears her own negative thoughts in her late grandmother's voice (Wikipedia).
